description: Source code for the TranslatorHLSL class, which handles translation of shader code to HLSL in the ANGLE project, including AST transformations and resource management.

classes.name: TranslatorHLSL
classes.description: Class responsible for translating shader code to HLSL, including AST transformations, resource management, and code output.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Performs the translation process on the shader AST, applying various AST transformations and resource handling.

methods.name: shouldFlattenPragmaStdglInvariantAll
methods.description: Indicates whether to flatten the stdgl invariant pragma; always returns false for HLSL.

methods.name: hasShaderStorageBlock
methods.description: Checks if a shader storage block with the given name exists.

methods.name: getShaderStorageBlockRegister
methods.description: Retrieves the register index for a given shader storage block.

methods.name: hasUniformBlock
methods.description: Checks if a uniform block with the given name exists.

methods.name: getUniformBlockRegister
methods.description: Retrieves the register index for a given uniform block.

methods.name: getUniformRegisterMap
methods.description: Returns the map of uniform register assignments.

methods.name: getReadonlyImage2DRegisterIndex
methods.description: Returns the register index for readonly 2D images.

methods.name: getImage2DRegisterIndex
methods.description: Returns the register index for 2D images.

methods.name: getUsedImage2DFunctionNames
methods.description: Returns the set of used image2D function names.
